To enable pause pod images to be pulled from private registries, allowing usage in air-gapped and on-premise environments where public registry access is restricted. [PR6672-c0]

To prevent the script from exiting prematurely when grep finds no matches, since the error condition is already handled later in the script. [PR1063-c0]
